tools.name: natal_chart
tools.description: Calculate a real natal (birth) chart from a birth date, optional birth time and a city. Returns the Sun, Moon and rising signs, every planet with sign, degree and house, the five tightest aspects, an element and modality summary, and a link to the free full chart with the wheel on lunonis.com. tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find birth cities by name. Returns up to 6 candidates { id, name, region, country }, the biggest first. Use it to disambiguate a city, then pass the chosen id as the place of natal_chart or compatibility.

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Compare two people's charts (synastry) from their birth data. Returns the overall tone (flowing, mixed or charged), whether the Sun elements match, the classic pairings (Venus-Mars, Sun-Moon, Moon-Moon, Venus-Venus), the tightest Moon, Venus, Mars and Sun contacts between the two charts, and a link
